title: Pathemari
desc: Narayanan, a young man, goes to Dubai to make a living. However, he faces many struggles but braves them for the sake of his family's well-being.

title: British Market
desc: Kunjamma and her sons run a business and lead a successful life. When Chennaikara, a thug, threatens them, her eldest son is determined to fight against him.

title: Oppam
desc: Jayaraman, a liftman and caretaker, relies on his non-visual senses and martial arts expertise to protect a little girl from a vengeful ex-con who is out to settle an old score.

title: Kerala State Lottery Result
desc: The host reveals the ticket numbers and announces the names of the people from the state of Kerala who have won the lottery.

title: Usthad
desc: An ex-gangster decides to move into his village with his sister. However, chaos ensues when a businessman frames him and gets him arrested.

title: Ponmuttayidunna tharavu
desc: Bhaskaran, a goldsmith, is madly in love with Snehalatha, the daughter of the astrologer, Panicker. When he asks for her hand in marriage, to his shock, she denies their love affair.

title: Chenkol
desc: Sethumadhavan accidentally kills a criminal to save his life and is sent to prison. After completing his sentence, he tries to lead a happy life, but his past makes it difficult.

title: Alakadalin Akkare
desc: Verendran, a smuggler, kills Mohan, a coast guard officer, only to discover that Mohan's father Balu is a witness. When Verendran sets out to kill Balu, his grandson Anand comes to his rescue.

title: Jeevitham
desc: Rajan, a hardworking mechanic, leaves his home with his wife after facing troubles with his sons. Things take a turn when he builds a fortune of his own with his mechanic expertise.

title: I. G. - Inspector General
desc: Inspector General Durga Prasad is promoted to head the anti-terrorism squad. However, things take a turn when he is forced to choose between his family and his job.

title: Idiots
desc: A wealthy heiress plans to implicate her former boyfriend for her murder by hiring an assassin. Things take a turn when a thief enters the house at the same time.

title: Take Off
desc: Sameera, an Indian nurse working in Iraq, and her colleagues are held hostage by terrorists. Later, Indian ambassador Manoj uses his wit to rescue them and get them out of the country alive.
